title: Kenneth R. French - Data Library
notes: Momentum factor detail page: https://mba.tuck.dartmouth.edu/pages/faculty/ken.french/data_library/det_mom_factor.html. Terms: the visible page shows no explicit licence, redistribution terms or citation request. An HTML source comment says images and code are Ken French's property and that reuse needs permission from French or Dimensional Fund Advisors. The page notes that full return histories are rebuilt at every monthly update and can change when CRSP revises its data, so record the download date and do not treat vintages as fixed. Data are built from CRSP (and Compustat links). Page showed data through August 2026 at access (2026-09-30). Redistribution rights for the data files are therefore unclear; safest to have users download them themselves and to cite the library.
